title.narrative: You Have a right, a choice … claim It!

description.narrative: 1) Research / Knowledge and Mobilization. 2) service delivery of Gender Based Violence. 3) Advocacy and Media campaigns and partnership network.

« You Have a Right a Choice Claim It » is a 3-year project that aims to increase knowledge and awareness on women’s rights through an integrated approach.
The project will run in parallel throughout the life cycle of the 3-year project. Disability-related activities are also designed to ensure that persons with disabilities are mainstreamed within all activities of the project. Monitoring and evaluation are ensured throughout the project with impact assessment. The project is implemented by King Hussein Foundation’s partners the Institute for Family Health (IFH), the Information and Research Center (IRCKHF) and I am Human for People with Disability.
